name: THOR Industries, Inc.
summary: THOR Industries, Inc. manufactures and sells recreational vehicles (RVs), and related parts and accessories in the United States, Germany, rest of Europe, Canada, and internationally. It operates through three segments: North American Towable Recreational Vehicles; North American Motorized Recreational Vehicles; and European Recreational Vehicles. The company offers travel trailers and motorhomes; Class A, Class C and Class B motorhomes; and fifth wheels under the Airstream Classic, Globetrotter, International, Tradewind, Flying Cloud, Caravel, Bambi, World Traveler, Basecamp, Interstate, Atlas, Rangeline, Jay Flight, Jay Feather, Eagle, Pinnacle, Colt, Range Lite, 3X, Prowler, North Trail, …
